business_problem: Dongfeng Nissan needed to strengthen finance-leasing risk models and process management while coping with hybrid-cloud complexity, connected-vehicle and user-data security exposure, and tighter cybersecurity and privacy regulations across the automotive sector.
solution_summary: Dongfeng Nissan used Tencent Cloud to combine finance-leasing risk control with automotive security and compliance on a shared cloud architecture. Tencent Financial Cloud provided compute, network, storage, database, security, and middleware services so the automaker could run risk workloads on elastic, reliable infrastructure. A big data platform and real-time multidimensional analysis turned accumulated business data into data-driven risk decisions, while NLP, speech recognition, and OCR added AI signals for verification and workflow innovation. For Dongfeng Nissan Finance Leasing, Tencent tailored a localized risk-control engine around the customer's scenarios and business processes. The broader solution also included an integrated security protection model spanning public-cloud controls, SOC-led private-cloud operations, zero-trust access, vehicle-security testing, and data-security governance, so risk, compliance, and automotive digital operations could be managed in one program.

data_flow: Finance-leasing application and operational data run on Tencent Financial Cloud and accumulate in the big data platform, where real-time multidimensional analysis and AI services such as NLP, speech recognition, and OCR enrich risk signals. The localized risk-control engine applies those signals to Dongfeng Nissan's approval and risk workflows, while the integrated security protection solution governs cloud, data, and user-journey security.
business_outcome: Tencent Cloud helped Dongfeng Nissan Finance Leasing improve approval accuracy and case pass rates, lower bad-debt rates, support about RMB 300 million in business within a little over four months of phase-one go-live, and put a stronger security and compliance framework around automotive digital operations.
